claim_language: On a frozen streaming Q15 db2 benchmark containing mutually exclusive, independently stateful one- and two-level decomposition contexts, ChiaMerge produced a candidate (sha256 27ce1aab1fc04c46...) that passed directed and randomized bit-exact RTL checks, a controller-only synthesized-netlist holdout, and frozen structural gates. The candidate used 8 normalized multiplication operators and synthesized to 6533 unweighted generic Yosys cells, 64.82% fewer than the sum of two explicitly unfolded references. This is controlled synthesis-level evidence of correct multirate resource folding under the tested contract; it is not an exhaustive proof, mapped-area or physical-PPA result, comparison with a best-known DWT implementation, or evidence of signal-processing quality.
